overview: Ruan Su married Bo Xingzhi, the president of Bo Group, out of gratitude. However, Bo Xingzhi mistakenly believed that Ruan Su was only after his money and considered their relationship to be nothing more than a contractual marriage, thus showing disdain for Ruan Su...
title: Beneath the Contract

overview: Mama na prenájom is a touching and suspenseful story in which the paths of two families cross thanks to chance and a little girl's wish to get to know her mother... Martin Toman, a successful gynaecologist and co-owner of a prestigious obstetric clinic, raises a kindergarten girl, Hana, alone with her father Ed. Her mother left them so long ago that Hanka doesn't remember her at all. However, Martin has unwisely promised Hanka that her mother will come for her sixth birthday, and now she has no idea how he will fulfill his promise. She finds unexpected salvation in the unbridled and somewhat crazy Nadi Vernerova, who runs the family restaurant with her father Dušan and siblings Beata and Juraj. Hana and Nadia are united by the fact that Nadia's mother has long been absent from the Verners' lives. The meeting of Nadia and Martin triggers a sequence of unexpected twists and events that will eventually intertwine the two families, flushing out dark secrets of the past while giving Hanka hope that one day she will indeed find her dream mother.
title: Mama na prenájom

overview: When twin sisters who are complete opposites face a turning point that forces them to "switch places" for an important task, things take an unexpected turn.
title: Rak Salap Lai

overview: Adultery has become so common and widespread that it does not even cause public condemnation. But when any particular woman, like the heroine of the film Larisa, unexpectedly encounters the infidelity of her own husband, she experiences it acutely, and other people's experience and other people's experiences offer little comfort. Although... As an energetic and pragmatic person, Larisa did not dwell on her grief, especially since fate specifically brings her together with women who have survived a similar blow. And she decides to unite them into the League of Betrayed Wives. In order to take revenge on unfaithful husbands. But life, as we know, brings its own surprises to our calculations, and what happened as a result of revenge will become clear only at the end of the film.
title: Лига обманутых жен

overview: During the Showa-era, newlyweds Natsumi Ebata and Takimasa Ebata enter an arranged marriage without a single day of courtship. Through tender yet exasperating moments, the two slowly bridge the gap between them, discovering love in the quiet routines of their shared days.
title: A Calm Sea and Beautiful Days with You

overview: It tells the story of the growth and love of jewelry designer Gu Nanxi. Gu Nanxi was in a car accident before the jewelry design competition, lost her sense of touch and was abandoned by her ex-boyfriend Xiao Rui. Three years later, Gu Nanxi returned to China, but her sense of touch had not fully recovered, and she was struggling in the design industry. By chance, she met the well-known artist Qin Shiqi, and with the help of Qin Shiqi, her sense of touch miraculously recovered. Gu Nanxi went to work at Keger Jewelry, where her ex-boyfriend Xiao Rui worked, and found that Xiao Rui not only abandoned her, but also stole her design results. Facing Xiao Rui's conspiracy, Gu Nanxi gradually won respect with her talent and perseverance, and fell in love with Qin Shiqi. However, their relationship encountered many obstacles, including the opposition of Gu Nanxi's best friend Qin Yufan and Xiao Rui's frame-up. Gu Nanxi finally won the championship of the 6th National Jewelry Design Competition with her strength, exposing Xiao Rui's true face, and overcame many difficulties with Qin Shiqi, harvested a beautiful love, and opened her own jewelry design studio.
title: I Remember Your Temperature

overview: A darkly gripping series, The Mortician chronicles a trusted family-owned funeral home that hid behind a façade of decency and propriety to take advantage of loved ones at their most vulnerable moments. In the early 1980s, David Sconce, scion of the Lamb family, took over the family business and sought to exploit the deceased in numerous ways to expand their earnings. Driven by profit, the Lamb Funeral Home in Pasadena, California engaged in years of morally questionable and inhumane practices.
title: The Mortician

overview: Big Brother: Unlocked features former winners hosting a deep-dive companion show to Big Brother, guiding viewers through never-before-seen footage, exclusive interviews, and behind-the-scenes access to analyze gameplay and offer an ultimate fan experience
title: Big Brother: Unlocked

overview: История конкурса Интервидение начинается с 1977 года. Можно считать, что конкурс начал свою историю в 1965 году с проведения международного телевизионного конкурса эстрадной песни «Золотой ключ» в Чехословакии, который проходил ежегодно до 1968 года. Однако официальное название «Интервидение» было принято только в 1977 году в Польше. Международный фестиваль популярной песни, который стал важной платформой для обмена культурным опытом и творческими достижениями между странами. 2025 год - Возрождение конкурса Интервидение.
title: Интервидение

overview: The iconic and award-winning Faking It is back and putting a new generation of fakers to the test. In each episode, a brave volunteer is dropped into a completely alien world and given just four weeks – and help from a handful of mentors – to master a new skill and convince a panel of experts that they are the real deal.
title: Faking It

overview: Guests who have the same name as famous persons, fictional characters, or things, are quizzed by celebrity panelists who try to determine their name.
title: The Name's the Same

overview: Born into beauty and poverty, Esh Esh is forced into becoming a dancer. She unexpectedly enters the world of the Greitleys, only to discover that her tragic fate was written long before she ever took the stage.
title: Esh Esh

overview: Karine et la maison jaune follows Karine Vanasse's new project: renovating an ancestral home bought on a whim.
title: Karine et la maison jaune

overview: Introducing Renovation Hunters, a new network original where home improvement meets the outdoor lifestyle. Hosted by Hal Shaffer, hunter and outdoorsman, this show is dedicated to preserving the family tradition of the outdoors. Our mission is to ensure that your hunting, fishing, or vacation camp can be passed on to the next generation. Our talented crew of Renovation Hunters is made of home improvement specialists from all over the United States, that love both their craft and the outdoors! If your selected, they will dedicate their skills for a solid week to do whatever it takes to ensure that your family camp is the place that your family memories will continue. See the trials, mishaps, and fun as the Renovation Hunters come to your town to preserve your family camp so you can enjoy the great outdoors again!
title: Renovation Hunters

overview: A heart-warming factual series that follows Kaikohe mother, first language speaker Clara Aperahama Kopa and her severely disabled son Mungzy, as they return for their second round of life-saving treatment at the world-renowned NAPA Therapy centre.
title: Nurturing Hope

overview: Generation Dating is a dating show designed to find out if you can really put an old head on young shoulders. Or ignite a young flame in an old heart. Each episode takes two perfect strangers, one older one younger and sets each of them a challenge: find the perfect date.
title: Generation Dating

overview: In this original series from Scripps News, we dive into the real-world influence of gaming — from its impact on technology and entertainment to politics and culture at large.
title: Next Level

overview: Operative Anton Shatalin from Semigorsk got bogged down in his work. To pay attention to the family, on his rare day off, Anton arranges a picnic, during which his wife disappears...
title: Домохозяин

overview: Fern Britton narrates this series that explores the close-knit community on Scilly.
title: Summer in the Scilly Isles
Si Fa Suo De Gu Shi

overview: Set against the backdrop of China's early Reform and Opening-Up era, the story spans the years leading up to the 1997 revisions of the Criminal Procedure Law and the Criminal Law. The central characters, Chen Yizhong, Yu Gaoyuan, Zhang Lihui, Xia Yingjie, and their fellow law school graduates, embark on careers in different branches of the justice system after graduation. Through the fast-paced evolution of judicial practice, they witness history, help shape it, adapt to the changing times, and grow both professionally and personally. Coming from different backgrounds and possessing distinct personalities, the group experiences the highs and lows of work and life over more than a decade, ultimately following very different paths. Told from the unique perspective of China's evolving judicial system, the drama brings together judges, prosecutors, police officers, and legal professionals to depict the sweeping history of the country's rule of law, while weaving together the intertwined fates of its characters amid a transformative era.
title: Forging Justice

overview: For the Broto family, managing their beloved Yogyakarta inn is no easy feat — especially when their youngest son falls in love with a married guest.
title: Losmen Bu Broto: The Series

overview: Ernie Dingo goes on a personal journey in order to get a unique understanding of how Aboriginal languages are shaped by ancestral connections to the land, stars, water, sea and the air we breathe.
title: Talking Language with Ernie Dingo

overview: Gu Xiaofeng goes to Haicheng to combat a plague, only to be ambushed and thrown into a lake. In her fading consciousness, she glimpses the silhouette of Ren Yi. When she awakens in the modern world, she resolves to stay by Dr. Ren Yi's side to uncover the truth—thus begins a tale that transcends two worlds.
title: Metro Medico

overview: Not content with hosting his Saturday Morning show, James Martin is now taking over our midweek afternoons. He hosts the series from his home in the Hampshire countryside, where he'll be revisiting favourite recipes from the aforementioned weekend show.
title: James Martin's Midweek Menu

overview: When a love story between a human and a crocodile begins, how will it end? Can they truly love each other? And will they be able to restore peace to the waters?
title: Love of the Two Realms

overview: Six stories from six different regions of Thailand: North, South, Isan, Central, East, and West.
title: Thun Thai

overview: It tells the story of Wen Dingyi, the daughter of a high-ranking official, who suffered the destruction of her family and disguised herself as a man to become the apprentice of an executioner. As a result, she happened to meet the twelfth brother of the current emperor, Yuwen Hongce. The two teamed up to explore the truth and encountered various funny accidents. From then on, they followed each other and started a warm, interesting and crisis-ridden journey in the world.
title: Love in Red Dust

overview: Sľub, set in the 1980s, will transport viewers, through strong stories full of emotions, humor, and drama, to a turning point forty years ago, when jeans could only be found in Tuzex, Spartakiad was practiced in free time, people knew that there was a different world beyond the borders, and the word emigration was only spoken in whispers... The plot takes place in an elementary school, which intertwines not only the destinies of students and teachers, but also entire families, which are marked by events in our country and in the surrounding world.
title: Sľub

overview: Each episode of Sports Gone Wrong blends comedic commentary with archival footage to break down jaw-dropping sports debacles — from controversial rule-breaking athletes and over-eager fans stealing home runs to infamous on-air moments, out-of-control fights, public scandals, unlikely injuries, and more. Salley, Godfrey, Smetana, and Virzi react to questionable NFL team theme songs; test Michael Jordan's cologne; play "Shaq Fu;" give their take on the infamous 1996 Orioles-Yankees Jeffrey Maier playoff game; pick sides in the 1984 Copa del Rey final brawl; and much more.
title: Sports Gone Wrong

overview: When Lukas wakes up after a heavy night of partying with no memory, he discovers a video circulating online in which he appears to murder someone. He flees in panic. With the help of Noa, the roommate of his missing girlfriend Ravi, he tries to find out what happened. But is Lukas as innocent as he claims? And why is Noa so keen to help him? Can she be trusted?
title: 96 Frames

overview: Throughout history, extreme weather events and catastrophic disasters - both natural and human made - have scarred and reshaped the Earth's surface. Though these events can wreak terrible destruction, they can also uncover incredible things. This documentary reveals mysterious curiosities that were once hidden from human eyes, only to be exposed by a calamitous incident.
title: Discovered by Disaster

overview: One starry night in 1986, the Tanner family get an unexpected houseguest - a furry, four-foot-high Alien Life Form they call ALF, who quickly becomes part of the family.
title: ALF

overview: Toradora SOS!: Hurray for Foodies is a set of four chibi-style comedy shorts bundled exclusively with the even-numbered Japanese Toradora! DVD volumes (2, 4, 6, and 8). Focused on lighthearted, food-themed adventures, the episodes feature recurring gags like Ryūji's trivia being ignored and Yūsaku declaring every contest a draw. These specials were never aired on TV and were released only as DVD bonus content, later included in some international editions.
title: Toradora SOS!: Kuishinbou Banbanzai

overview: Shuichirou is in the habit of sneaking into the terrace of his school building during lunch, while skipping class, or when he wants to put off going home. There, he often meets with Konno. Konno is a guy shrouded in rumour: with some saying he's dark and intimidating but others claiming he's a photography enthusiast and an unexpectedly nice guy. Jealousy, envy, and an odd sort of mutual regard colours the interactions between these two young men: one who conceals his feelings behind a cheerful facade and the other whose simple-minded, pure-hearted demeanour makes his friend's previously avoidant existence rife with internal conflict...
title: Hishakai Shindo

overview: When a long-neglected housewife befriends a mysterious woman who is her polar opposite, the two women find that they have far more in common than they thought. As their friendship unfolds, we soon learn that they both harbor secrets that could quickly unravel their quiet suburban lives.
title: Strangers

overview: A blood-red revenge drama in which a man who was living normally returns from hell when his life suddenly falls into abyss one day.
title: The Manipulated

overview: A Saudi man is past the usual marriageable age, which makes him vulnerable to numerous family and societal pressures urging him to marry. His mother and those close to him try to help him find a suitable wife, but he tries to evade them in various ways.
title: Diary of a Spinster

overview: Jesy Nelson: Life After Little Mix follows Jesy Nelson as she embarks on the most transformative journey yet - motherhood. With her life in the public eye for over a decade as one -fourth of the global pop phenomenon Little Mix, Jesy has experienced the highest of highs and the lowest of lows. Now, she's ready to share her truth like never before.
title: Jesy Nelson: Life After Little Mix

overview: Dr. Andrej Fabián is one of the best internal medicine doctors in Slovakia, but his relationship with his patients is completely impersonal. He doesn't call them by their names, but by their bed number. He is not interested in their personal lives, only in their laboratory reports. Zero empathy, zero compassion, zero emotional involvement. One night, however, the personal life of a patient who died in his ward catches up with him cruelly: the patient's father, distraught with grief, shoots him in the head. Fabian does not die, but when he wakes up, he quickly realizes that what has happened to him may be far worse than death: the head wound has erased all his memories of the past twelve years. The only thing Fabian can cling to to keep from falling into despair is to get back to his work. But something has changed in him: being a patient has completely upended his approach to medicine. And although he cannot now rely on his medical knowledge, which is 12 years old, he can use his renewed capacity for emotional engagement.
title: Druhá šanca

overview: Life as a couple brings many challenges and problems that partners or spouses have to overcome every day. The unconventional series format is made up of short, entertaining clips that give an insight into the everyday life of a mature couple. It presents scenes from everyday partner life and offers advice on how to prevent conflicts or, when they do arise, how to resolve them gracefully.
title: Tomáš a Diana

overview: The story of the series takes place in the picturesque and somewhat sleepy town of Tichý Brod, surrounded by beautiful nature, whose peaceful atmosphere and relations between the inhabitants are disturbed by the brutal murder of an 11-year-old boy, Daniel. The investigation is led by local police captain Elena Mikušová (Gabriela Marcinková) together with her new colleague, Major Adam Hanzel (Tomáš Maštalír), whose aloof and socially inept approach initially complicates their cooperation. Gradually, however, they uncover not only the clues leading to the killer, but also the secrets that the town's inhabitants have been hiding from the others for years... The new series is a Slovak adaptation of the successful British format Broadchurch. The original series was a worldwide success and won millions of fans with its captivating story that reveals human fates and dark secrets against the backdrop of a shocking murder.
title: Vina

overview: What happens when you find out your entire world was never meant for you? An affluent man and his ordinary counterpart find out in a hilarious life swap.
title: Nuevo Rico, Nuevo Pobre

overview: In the early 1980s, Pingchuan County decided to set up "Yuehai Town" in order to accelerate development. Li Qiu Ping and Zheng De Cheng, two cadres with outstanding abilities and personalities, adhered to the concept of "the people's city is built by the people", and with the help of the reform and opening-up policy and the Central Document No. 1, they found a way to reform and led thousands of farmers to build a modern city on the tidal flats through the "fund-raising and partnership" initiative without using a penny from the state.
title: The Dream Maker

overview: A mysterious sect manipulates fate to scam the innocent. When revenge driven Shangguan Chengming crosses paths with his enemy Jiang Feiyan again, he sets a trap, using deception against deceivers. But as schemes collide and twists unfold, the game grows more dangerous, who will outsmart whom in the end?
title: A Prophet

overview: 8 singles move into a villa, unaware that their exes will soon arrive with good or bad intentions. Their dream vacation turns into a real nightmare.
title: Ex on the Beach France

overview: Interesting profiles on legendary automobiles, manufacturers and personalities.
title: A CARography

overview: The documentary series, Train Rescue Down Under, follows trains, railway workshops and the people working on the trains from across Australia.
title: Train Rescue Down Under

overview: Power gave them access. Evil drove their crimes. Prepare for a chilling investigation into some of the darkest stories in modern crime history. Each episode reveals the terrifying truth of abuse of power committed by those in positions of authority.
title: American Monster: Abuse of Power

overview: Olga Morozova, an investigator of the Moscow Prosecutor's office for particularly important cases, returns to her hometown of Bliznerechensk to take care of her mother, who was robbed the day before. Olga cannot leave her mother alone in such a difficult condition and decides to move to the province.
title: Крутые берега

overview: The life of businessman Mikhail Dmitrievich Svirelnikov is going quite well. But he understands perfectly well that his ex-wife, mistress and daughter want only one thing from him - money. In order to provide for them, Mikhail has to commit fraud. One day, noticing surveillance, Svirelnikov understands that someone has revealed his secrets, and begins his investigation...
title: Грибной царь

overview: A film about love, about life, about betrayal, and about how to overcome the troubles that we create for ourselves throughout our lives. This is the story of the reunion of the three Korolev sisters.
title: Сёстры Королёвы

overview: A story about the life of our contemporary Alexander Novgorodtsev, forty-two years old, from his four friends, each of whom defends his own version of what happened. But, no matter how much all four of them disagree in their assessment of certain events, they agree on one thing: their Sashka is the last romantic idealist who managed to perform an "ordinary miracle", usually called "success", to reach "amazing heights" and at the same time not bend one iota to the changing world. The boaster Valentin, the emotional Mikhail, the gallant Igor and the reasonable Veniamin lead their narrative.
title: Неудачников.net

overview: The heroes of the series are clients of an ordinary beauty salon "Faces". As usual, when they come to the salon, they tell their, sometimes the most incredible, stories of Love. Some of them are impossible to believe, others will turn out to be just a figment of their imagination and not all will end with a happy ending. The beauty salon will become that "magical" place where everyone will reveal their most intimate love secrets: different and at the same time close to each other. And the grateful listeners will be the visitors of the salon and, of course, its employees.
title: Любовь и прочие глупости

overview: 60-year-old businessman Pyotr Gavrilovich Kuznetsov is a handsome man in the prime of life. He is not used to denying himself pleasures and bathes in luxury, having fun with his young mistress. But suddenly everything changes: a terrible illness takes away his former strength, and his life collapses before his eyes. His son, with whom Pyotr Gavrilovich has not communicated for many years, is in no hurry to help, and the woman, who was recently burning with passion, runs away from him without a second thought...
title: Жил-был дед

overview: An ordinary high school has a basketball section that all eighth-graders want to get into. But the path is open only to a select few, because the invited coach Sergeeva has her own strict selection criteria. Those who are unlucky decide to succeed in basketball at any cost. Many obstacles arise on their way, but the guys overcome them all and prove to others that they, too, can become an equally strong and friendly basketball team. And most importantly, the boys and girls become a team for life! Each episode is a complete story, a significant episode from the lives of very different teenagers who are united by "Your Team". They solve problems, achieve success, fall in love. They become Personalities!
title: Своя команда

overview: The tragic tale of Maggie Tulliver, the miller's daughter, who defies her embittered brother in standing by the man she loves - shocking the stifling society in which she lives - in an attempt to pursue her blighted dreams
title: The Mill on the Floss

overview: Katie navigates adulthood post-breakup, guided by her inner voices: Logic, Heart, Anxiety, and Lady Parts. She faces life's challenges while balancing desires and needs, learning to accept all aspects of herself through humor and growth.
title: The Kouncil

overview: Old friends JD and Turk scrub in together for the first time in a long time, learning that medicine has changed; interns have changed; but their bromance has stood the test of time.
title: Scrubs

overview: In the 1990s, Chen Yi and Miao Jing grow up together but are separated by tragedy and a criminal case. Years later, they reunite, fight a crime network, and finally end up together.
title: Love For You

overview: Naši presents the life of a family of five with occasional slightly ironic undertones, so natural for normal relationships between children and parents. Every week, a father and mother struggling to raise their three sons invite us into their daily routine and offer us a tasty cocktail of varied emotions, laughter and screams. Every parent can easily identify with their stories and situations full of humour, but also tenderness and heart-warming human warmth. They provoke us to laugh, smile or think, and the occasional gnashing of teeth cannot be ruled out. Our heroes undoubtedly succeed in dramatically changing the optics through which we view the contemporary family, while sending a reassuring signal to us all that we parents - or our children - are not alone in this.
title: Naši

overview: When the naked body of a man wearing a bull's head is discovered at the Gare de Bordeaux-St-Jean, Captain Anais Chatelet is the first detective on the scene. That evening, an amnesiac is found wandering along the road carrying a car wrench covered in blood. He is taken to a nearby psychiatric institution and placed under the care of psychiatrist Mathias Freire. Before long, Anais's investigations into the murder introduce her to the Greek myth of the Minotaur and she becomes increasingly suspicious of Mathias. With Jean-Hugues Anglade, Raphaelle Agogue, Michael Cohen, Hocine Choutri, Didier Flamand and Mathieu Simonet.
title: Le passager

overview: Explore the many lives of Martin Scorsese through intimate interviews with the man himself, access to his private archives, plus conversations with Robert De Niro, Leonardo DiCaprio, Margot Robbie, Daniel Day-Lewis, Steven Spielberg, and more.
title: Mr. Scorsese

overview: Narrated by The Project's own frequent flyer and funny woman Susie Youssef, this series taxis viewers behind the scenes of Melbourne Airport, Australia's busiest 24-hour runway to the world. Last year, 35 million passengers and thousands of flights passed through its terminals. But behind every seamless departure and arrival is a team of dedicated professionals working around the clock to ensure the airport runs safely and efficiently. This gripping documentary series follows the air traffic controllers who navigate congested skies, ensuring aircraft land and take off without a hitch. On the ground, baggage handlers, security teams, customs officers, and emergency responders work tirelessly to keep everything moving, often under intense pressure. Whether it's managing last-minute flight diversions, responding to medical emergencies, or handling unexpected security threats, every shift presents a new challenge. With exclusive access to restricted areas and high-pressure moments, this is your boarding pass to the world behind the departures board — a place where no two days are the same and every second counts. So fasten your seatbelts, stow your tray tables, and prepare for departure — because Airport 24/7 is about to land on your screens.
title: Airport 24/7

overview: For the first time, Papini shares her account of events as she recalls them, offering rare insights into her mindset during her disappearance and the subsequent investigation into her abduction claims upon her return home.
title: Sherri Papini: Caught in the Lie

overview: Three con artists Marina, Sveta and Olya successfully pose as mediums until they accidentally receive a real gift from a street witch. Now Marina can hear thoughts, Sveta can see the future, and Olya can see the dead. New abilities turn the girls' lives into hell, so the friends decide to find someone who will take these "gifts" for themselves. In search of the perfect candidate, the girls meet not only the insidious sorcerer-tempter, but also the second halves.
title: Химкинские ведьмы

overview: The thrilling family adventure series is set at mysterious Crookhaven School where high achieving young crooks from across the world are secretly selected to hone their skills in disciplines such as Deception, Crimnastics, Forgery and Infiltration, learning how to use their skills for good and to do what is right in their own way. Centred around pickpocketing genius Gabriel and his archrival, headmaster's daughter Penelope, the series follows a group of eight very different, young international students as they compete for the coveted Crooked Cup. In a school where every teacher is a crook and traitors lurk around every corner, no-one is entirely who they seem to be as the gang uncover the dark secrets that link Penelope's missing mother with Gabriel's own mysterious past and confront a terrifying enemy - The Nameless. A coming-of-age drama full of exciting twists and turns, Crookhaven is about finding your place in the world, learning who you can trust and the very nature of right and wrong.
title: Crookhaven

overview: Margarita lives a double life. In one life, she is a modest literature teacher at school, a wonderful wife and mother. In the other, she is a bright and mysterious singer at a night restaurant. The heroine performs in a mask under the pseudonym Greta and carefully hides her identity not only from the public, but also from her family: her mother, daughter Zhenya and husband Victor. However, deception plays a cruel joke on her. During one of her performances, Margo notices her husband in the audience in the arms of his mistress Vika, the daughter of his boss. She decides to follow them, but eventually finds Vika dead. Margarita realizes that all suspicions will now fall on her. In addition, the girl's influential father will not stop until he finds the killer and punishes him. This means that Margo's fate is unenviable. Together with Victor, Margo decides not to go to the police, but to hide the girl's body in the forest. So the heroine finds herself in a trap from which there seems to be no way out...
title: Тайная жизнь Маргариты

overview: It tells the story of Gerluce, a woman of the people, who did everything to prevent her teenage daughter from repeating the fate of her mother and grandmother, Lígia. But when her heiress becomes pregnant, the young woman is capable of a desperate act.
title: Três Graças

overview: Elizaveta Listova's documentary is dedicated to one of the most tense and least known periods of the Cold War. Unlike the Cuban Missile Crisis, when the world stood on the brink of nuclear war in front of everyone's eyes, the events of 1983 developed in such a spontaneous way that humanity could perish without even realizing what had actually happened. In 1983, at the peak of a zealous political battle with its salvos of the main propaganda calibers, a whole series of random events occurs, each of which only miraculously does not become the beginning of the end of civilization. On the night of September 1, 1983, a foreign plane was shot down by the Soviet military off the Far Eastern coast, having penetrated more than 500 kilometers into the country's airspace. By all indications, the plane was an American reconnaissance aircraft - such aircraft often flew along the coast of the USSR, but it turned out to be a civilian aircraft of Korean Airlines, which for unknown reasons had deviated from its usual course. Almost a month later, at the command post of the space echelon of the missile attack warning system, an alert was triggered about the launch of nuclear missiles by the Americans towards the USSR. The entire political background spoke of the regularity of this event. But in the few minutes that were given to the combat crew to analyze the situation, the commander of this crew figured out that the alert was false, a malfunction of the system itself, and interrupted the chain of information that would inevitably lead to the command to launch nuclear missiles in response. But a month later, the strategic forces of the Soviet Union were put on heightened combat readiness. Because, according to the Soviet military, the American strategic forces were put on readiness No. 1 - "a nuclear war is inevitable." It took titanic operational efforts by the intelligence services of the USSR and the GDR to understand that the highest combat readiness declared by the Americans was a training exercise. NATO countries were conducting large-scale exercises to practice launching nuclear missiles with new codes and a radio silence regime that left their opponents no chance to distinguish the exercises from reality. This could have been another point of no return. And the Americans did not immediately learn about the Soviet Union's hyperreaction. And when they did, they did not immediately believe that the Union seriously feared that the United States would use nuclear weapons first. Both of these potentially fatal incidents were never public knowledge. But they are the ones that bring the most important player to the field of political games - chance. The documentary film "1983" will be devoted to the role of chance in history.

45 дней до Победы is a project dedicated to the heroic deeds of people during the Great Patriotic War. Pioneer partisans, scientists of besieged Leningrad, signalmen, artists, athletes, nurses, translators, priests - none of them were ready for war, but each made an invaluable contribution to bringing the long-awaited Victory closer. Each episode reflects one year of a terrible period for the country - from the beginning of the invasion to the final defeat of the enemy in 1945.
title: 45 дней до Победы

overview: Mom, dad, two sons, one at the institute, the other works as a bodyguard. If you look at them, they seem like an ordinary family. If you meet one of them in a crowd of city passers-by, you won't pay attention to them – they are invisible. This is only to their advantage, because while you don't notice them, they look at you and see everything that you would hardly want to show to anyone. Everything falls into place when you learn the past of Larisa and Viktor (mom and dad): until recently, they worked in the seventh department of the KGB. Today they are already retired, but, as we know, there are no former employees of the security services, and they continue to engage in surveillance privately and on private orders.
